name: Bühelwirt
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bühelwirt in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. At **Bühelwirt**, we invite you to savor traditional flavors in a cozy mountain setting.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy pancake torn into pieces and dusted with powdered sugar—best enjoyed with fresh fruit or a dollop of apricot jam. Pair it with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a warm **Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

Our rustic **Hausmannskost** (homestyle dishes) includes hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** (a crispy potato and bacon hash) and tender **Kassler mit Semmelknödeln** (roast pork with dumplings). For meat lovers, try our slow-roasted **Wildschweinbraten** (wild boar) or a juicy **Rindergulasch** (beef goulash).

After your meal, relax with a **Schnaps** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** (Tyrolean beer) by the fireplace. The views of the surrounding peaks—especially from our sunlit terrace—are simply breathtaking.

Whether you're here for a quick lunch or a leisurely dinner, **Bühelwirt** promises an unforgettable taste of **Tirol**. Come experience the warmth of Alpine tradition in **Innsbruck** or the charming villages nearby.

**Prost und an Guadn!** (Cheers and enjoy!)
